# Track Studio 1.3.0-rc.202611282352

## 中文

本轮让曲库侧边栏在较矮的双轨窗口里整列滚动，并把分轨、模型和 Rekordbox 运行时的下载代码移出主进程启动包。

### 曲库侧边栏

- 双轨模式下，侧边栏图标整列一起滚动，不再把上面的核心图标固定住。
- 窗口较矮时，下面的设备图标仍能滚到；当前选中的图标会滚进可见区域。

### 启动与探测

- 分轨运行时、Demucs 模型和 Rekordbox 桌面运行时的下载实现不再打进主进程启动包，真正下载或分轨时才加载。
- 设备探测成功时不再把可选后端的说明写成错误日志。XPU 可用时仍优先使用 XPU，CPU 只在 XPU 实际失败后才使用。

## English

This build lets the library sidebar scroll as one column in a short dual-deck window, and moves stem, model, and Rekordbox runtime download code out of the main-process startup bundle.

### Library sidebar

- In dual-deck mode the sidebar icons scroll together instead of pinning the core icons at the top.
- On a short window the device icons below remain reachable, and the selected icon scrolls into view.

### Startup and probing

- Stem runtime, Demucs model, and Rekordbox desktop runtime download code is no longer in the main-process startup bundle. It loads only when a download or stem job actually runs.
- A successful device probe no longer records optional-backend notes as errors. When XPU is available it is still tried before CPU; CPU is used only if the XPU run fails.
